issue.title: block-marks e2e self-test forbids 2026-11-20 in generated fixture, so today+4 on 2026-11-16 fails
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-lt.land while landing epic bob-cli-lt. The landing tale did not touch this file. Fails alone and under `npm test`.

## What fails

`scripts/test-obsidian-block-marks-e2e.cjs` (`obsidian-block-marks-e2e --self-test`) throws:

```
Error: fixture must use relative dates, not hardcoded contract dates
```

at `scripts/obsidian-block-marks-e2e.cjs:1093`:

```
if (marks.includes("2026-11-20")) throw new Error("fixture must use relative dates, not hardcoded contract dates");
```

The fixture is built with `dates.plus4 = addDays(today, 4)`. On 2026-11-16 that is `2026-11-20`, so a relative date collides with the forbidden contract-date literal. The check is a time bomb: it fails on every calendar day where today+4 (or another offset written into `marks`) equals 2026-11-20.

Fix: assert the generator uses `addDays` / `dates.plusN` rather than scanning generated bytes for one ISO string.

## CI failure

- **Node:** `scripts/test-obsidian-block-marks-e2e.cjs`
